performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; spend grew into a low-conversion window, not creative failure.

findings.text: 28-day ROAS is 4.48x but the 7d window dropped -69.84%; last 3 days (Sep 7–9) show 7 purchases vs 8 in prior 3 (Sep 4–6) while spend held ~$161 vs ~$195 — purchases softening as spend pulled back, not collapsing.

Sep 8 produced $450.98 revenue on $61.20 spend (7.4x ROAS); Sep 9 produced $0 revenue on $40.59 spend — single-day zero is noise but revenue is extremely lumpy, making weekly ROAS unreliable as a signal.
5 overdue SOW milestones (Aug 14–31): Live-Cooking Shoot 1, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM live, SEO Phase 1 Guardrails — all unconfirmed complete as of Sep 10.

GBP actions dropped -47.49% week-over-week and have shown zero actions for 3 consecutive days (Sep 7–9), down from a 25–40/day baseline — probable GBP listing issue or data feed break, not organic demand loss.
Aug 30 spend was $0.42 (effectively zero), breaking the $40–70/day run — a one-day anomaly but confirms no delivery floor protection on the account.

suggestions.text: Hold current Meta spend; re-check ROAS over next 3 days before any budget move — revenue too lumpy to act on -69.84% delta alone.
suggestions.monday_update: Do not adjust Meta budgets this cycle. The 7d ROAS delta of -69.84% is distorted by extremely lumpy revenue — Sep 8 alone delivered $450.98 at 7.4x while Sep 9 delivered $0, making the window untrustworthy. Re-check on Sep 13 with the full Sep 7–12 purchase and revenue series; if ROAS remains below 3x across all 6 days, escalate to a budget reduction.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing immediately — 3 consecutive zero-action days against a 25–40/day baseline signals a feed or verification break.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have read zero for Sep 7, 8, and 9, against a prior baseline of 25–40 actions/day and a 28-day total of 663 actions. This is likely a listing suspension, ownership verification lapse, or data connector outage — not an organic demand drop. Check GBP dashboard for suspension flags and confirm the data connector is pulling. Success: GBP actions resume above 15/day by Sep 13.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer (Ops); Funnel Test + UTM gap is directly blocking attribution reliability.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones passed their Aug 14–31 deadlines with no confirmed completion: Live-Cooking Shoot 1, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails. The Funnel Test and UTM milestone is the most critical — without it, Meta purchase attribution via Windsor remains unverified and every ROAS number is soft. Nacer to provide status on all five by Sep 12; UTM/funnel closure is a prerequisite before any budget scaling decision.
